description: PART OF THE FAMILY. A big adventure is waiting for you. Riding a bicycle is the first step to independence and the bike is more than a simple product. It’s your best friend, your brother, a part of the family. From the 10-inch balance bike to the 26-inch bicycle, KTM redeveloped the entire range in 2021 and further optimised it to this day. With lightweight aluminium frames, child-oriented components and specifically chosen technical concepts, all bikes are made to fit children’s bodies.
